value.rationale: The fixed total number of contacts creates a natural resource-allocation trade-off: reducing high-risk degrees increases others, and the SIR excess-degree term makes it non-obvious a priori whether anti-correlation improves invasion control. The complete sharp staircase distinguishes the first risk ratio at which redistribution is beneficial, all subsequent optimal contact reallocations, and the terminal high-risk leaf regime. A small exact example changes the invasion classification with unchanged mean degree. The fact is a motivated full classification rather than a narrow arbitrary parameter sample; no field feasibility claim is made.
